evidence.evidence_text: Recent advancements in NLP, largely driven by Large Language Models (LLMs), have significantly improved performance on an array of tasks.
This paper investigates the root causes of LLMs’ poor performance in DA classification through a linguistically motivated analysis.
We identify three key pre-tasks essential for accurate DA prediction: Turn Management, Communicative Function Identification, and Dialogue Structure Prediction.
